_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: Open-slot pass rather than a prune - nothing removed and nothing added, because the file holds one row, SMCI on 8/11, and 8/11 is still ahead. What this run did to it is the thing the row existed for: impliedMove goes from null to 0.142. The straddle was pulled live and the number is 14.2% on tomorrow night's print, which turns this row from an open checklist item into a settled refusal. Also re-read: spot to the live 09:46 bid of 32.52 from the 30.94 Friday left, a 5.1% drift over a weekend that would have made any implied range struck off the stale figure wrong in the flattering direction; and the calendar itself, where the estimate now reads 0.88 against the 0.69 carried since 8/7. The forward calendar was swept again for the other eleven watched names and none has a catalyst in the window, so SMCI remains the correct entire contents of this file rather than the only leftover - and that fact is what forced today's entry, because a board with exactly one forward catalyst that the rules refuse is a board on which item 1 cannot be passed.

moves.source: Straddle pulled live at 09:45 ET on 8/10 by the open run, discharging the item Friday's pre-close handed to this slot by name. The SMCI 2026-08-14 32 call marks 2.51 (2.47 bid / 2.55 ask, 2,399 open interest) and the 32 put marks 2.05 (2.00 bid / 2.10 ask, 645 open interest), a 4.56 straddle against a 32.21 spot at the moment it was struck - 14.2%, recorded here as 0.142. spot is the live 09:46 bid of 32.52, replacing the 30.94 carried from Friday's close. Calendar re-verified live: 8/11, timing pm, verified true, no actual. The estimate now reads 0.88, correcting the 0.69 this board carried since 8/7 - the live calendar is the authority and the row moved to it rather than the other way round. impliedMove is no longer null and this row is no longer an open item.

branches.cond: An equity entry considered on SMCI before the 8/11 close
branches.act: Refused. The number is in hand and it refuses the trade.
branches.why: The straddle is now pulled, so item 3 is satisfied and it decides against the hold rather than merely permitting it to be considered. A 14.2% implied move against the rulebook's -8% equity stop means the stop sits entirely inside the event: the realistic bad case gaps through it rather than filling at it, so the exit written before entry would not be the exit taken. That is a mechanical refusal, not a view on whether the report is good.

branches.cond: An option considered on this name at any time before the print
branches.act: Refused outright, and it was never reachable
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print - IV crush kills even a correct call - and any 3-6 week expiry from here necessarily spans 8/11. The straddle does not enter into it; this branch closes on the calendar alone.

branches.cond: SMCI still wanted after the print
branches.act: Re-approach from 8/12, on the reaction bar rather than into it
branches.why: The post-print session is the first point at which this name is available to the rulebook at all, and item 2 will then govern: the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2/3 pullback that holds is. Recorded now so a post-print entry is a decision made in advance rather than a reflex on the day.
